morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为完整专名使用，不拆为 ke- 等马来语词缀；英语常见读音如所列，个人读法应以本人为准。资料包未提供音节划分或爪夷文，保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 凯文：男性名字；在马来语句子中作为人名使用。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name of Irish origin, used as a personal name in Malay discourse.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas lelaki yang berasal daripada nama Ireland dan digunakan untuk merujuk individu yang mempunyai nama tersebut.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，规范拼写为 Kevin；键名的小写形式沿用输入。以下搭配是常用人名称谓结构，并非该名字独有的固定搭配。status 沿用指定记录标签，不表示 Kevin 是获 DBP 认证的马来语普通词。名字来源及英语读音参见 [Behind the Name：Kevin](https://www.behindthename.com/name/kevin)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Encik Kevin akan membentangkan laporan kemajuan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 凯文先生将在明天的会议上汇报项目进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Kevin will present the project progress report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kevin dah sampai kat kafe ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Kevin sudah tiba di kafe?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Kevin arrived at the café yet?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
kat 在此相当于地点介词 di。
句末 ke 构成口语疑问。

messages.ms_spoken: Kevin dah sampai kat kafe ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Kevin sudah tiba di kafe?
messages.en: Has Kevin arrived at the café yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tengah tunggu kita. Jom cepat sikit.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba dan sedang menunggu kita. Marilah kita bergegas sedikit.
messages.zh: 到了，他正等我们呢。咱们快一点吧。
messages.en: Yes, he's waiting for us. Let's hurry up a bit.

etymology.historical_story: Kevin is the English form of the Irish name Caoimhín, historically associated with Old Irish Cóemgein. Its elements concern being dear or beloved and birth. Saint Kevin of Glendalough helped preserve the name in Irish religious tradition. In Malay sentences, however, Kevin identifies a person; its historical meaning is not translated. [Source: Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/kevin).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Kevin ≈「凯文」：把读音与一张写着 Kevin 的姓名牌绑定，整词记住，不拆成马来语前缀。
